attempted_claim: There exist aperiodic binary Toeplitz subshifts (X,S) and (Y,S) with zero topological entropy, maximal equicontinuous factor the binary odometer, unique ergodicity with affinely homeomorphic singleton measure simplices, order-isomorphic unital dimension groups hence strong orbit equivalence, and the same n log n factor-complexity growth class, such that X and Y are not topologically conjugate, as witnessed by centralizers with one trivial and one containing an involution.
claim_type: Borel-reducibility dichotomy with turbulence obstruction witness
decisive_failure: Finite-stage Toeplitz computations saturate at the resolution limit (periodic approximants), so numerics alone cannot certify Theta(n log n) growth, unique ergodicity, dimension-group isomorphism, or full centralizer structure; the infinite-family proofs (all ordered-group maps, all block-code radii, two-sided complexity bounds) remain unbuilt and would require a fresh construction program beyond this pass.
